question: Should hydrogen separation technologies be included if they are not directly part of a storage process? (현재 가정: Include only those that are part of a storage process.)
why_needed: 측정: 풀 표본 60건 중 38건(~63%)의 판정이 넓게/좁게에 따라 갈립니다. Determines if separation technologies that purify hydrogen but do not store it are included.
answer: Include hydrogen separation/purification when it serves storing or delivering stored hydrogen.
